quest.title: The Flowers That Won't Grow
quest.description: Herb grower Vardan and his son Gurgen are distressed by something...

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: We can't go on like this, Father. The roses are not growing well.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: We must work out something quick, or we won't be able to deliver all the herbs on time this year!

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: The soil is good. We've disposed of the weeds and pests. So what's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's bothering you?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you here to buy herbs?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Well, we send batches of herbs to Bimarstan at regular intervals.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: The most important herb of all is the special "Sumeru Rose."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Roses can be used as medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: That's a question you need to direct toward the doctors at Bimarstan.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: They say the rose can be used in tandem with other medicines to cure heatstroke and soothe stomachaches, and that it even has some other benefits... none of which I recall at the moment.

choices.text: In that case, I'll help out.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: For some reason, it is growing incredibly slowly.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Our experience tells us that this is usually either a soil or a pest problem.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: But we have planted other herbs here using the same soil, and those have grown up just fine.

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: We also perform pest control every day. So it can't be the pests...

response.speaker: Gurgen
response.text: This is no time to get obsessed with the possibilities. Any more stalling, and we won't be able to deliver the roses to Bimarstan on time.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Our current plan is to fertilize the soil with a special fertilizer.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: But we need to take care of other fields at the same time. As such, we haven't any time left to collect materials for the fertilizer.

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Traveler, for the sake of the patients at Bimarstan, would you please do us this favor?

response.speaker: Vardan
response.text: Let's see. Our current situation is...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: We'll need a lot of special fertilizer.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: We have some reserves of other ingredients for this type of special fertilizer, but we have run out of Harra Fruit.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, could we trouble you to get us some Harra Fruits?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Soil fertility aside, perhaps "water" might also be a problem...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Maybe we buried the rose so deep that it couldn't get enough water?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help us water the rose, please?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: These will do the trick. Thank you so much, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: With this special fertilizer, the fertility of the soil shouldn't be a problem, and the rose will surely grow well.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Let's hope they'll actually take effect this time, unlike the ones we've used before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've tried using fertilizers before already?

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: We did use some ordinary ones. They didn't work well... Well, they didn't work at all.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: But they did amazingly in the other fields. Honestly, I wonder what's going on here...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Well, we shan't keep you any further. Take these as our thanks, please.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Whew... The soil should have enough moisture for now.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: Many thanks, Traveler. We could have been all tuckered out by now if it wasn't for you.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Strange... It took so much water to permeate the soil thoroughly this time.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: I felt like we used at least twice as much water as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: That can't be. Maybe you're just too tired.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: If we really had doubled the amount of water, the soil would be soaked. But see, the moisture levels seem normal.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: I guess so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I hope the roses will grow well.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: No worries. We will take good care of the roses for the sake of the patients and doctors at Bimarstan.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, take these as our thanks, please.

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Still, I really feel like we used a lot more water than usual this time...

dialogues.speaker: Vardan
dialogues.text: Traveler, please help us water the nearby roses.

dialogues.speaker: Gurgen
dialogues.text: With enough water, the roses will definitely start growing again!
